2026-11-07 live: ENGAGE is two-step: approach_px -> wait approach_wait_s -> guardian_px. Clicking the guardian body while standing on the non-walkable glass only walks the character; it never starts a fight. Whole posture is retried at most 3 rounds, then BLOCKED. Tactical constants (gameops, same session): F3-F7 = 3300-3630 XP/floor, 30-37 s/floor, PP -1/floor, F8 also uses the two-step posture, no bottom bar => travel is impossible inside; PP-out and defeat paths still UNOBSERVED.

2026-11-07: guardian moves per floor, so ENGAGE sweeps tower.guardian_sweep_px (approach -> wait -> each candidate until battle markers; whole posture <=2 rounds, <=12 guardian clicks, then BLOCKED). RunBattle consumes the reward panels and returns rewards=[], xp=0.0, so progress is ALSO verified independently via tower.pet_panel every --verify-every cycles: xp_to_next decreasing or level increasing => PROGRESS (xp_source=pet_panel_delta).
